parsed.summary: Dealer Little Rock, AR asked where to find the new brochure PDF. The supply chain control tower identified this as a non-operational event. No plant operations or shipments were affected.
parsed.decision_reason: No action was taken because the message names no shipment, plant, part, lot or date and describes no disruption to production, dealers, loaners or owners. Per handbook rule 7, noise gets no write tools.
